execution.kind: read-only metadata and memory-mapped edge audit
method: Load neurons.npz without pickle and indices.npy/counts.npy with NumPy memory mapping.
Count exact metadata values with boolean equality masks; nonempty field coverage is count(value != '').
For each effective neurotransmitter k, source-edge count is count(effective_nt[indices] == k) and source-synapse count is sum(counts[effective_nt[indices] == k]).
Zero-coupling edge and synapse counts use sign[indices] == 0.
No graph state was advanced and no service or resident was contacted.

dataset.name: MaleCNS connectome
dataset.scope: adult male Drosophila brain and ventral nerve cord; curated Traced neurons

broad_efferent.selection: repository efferent selector: superclass contains '_motor' or '_efferent', or starts with 'efferent_'
broad_efferent.distinction: This broader interface population includes 110 non-cb_motor/non-vnc_motor efferents and must not be reported as 925 motor neurons.

auditory.omission_reason: One auditory row has an empty superclass; current V2 body rows select only cb_sensory or vnc_sensory.

chordotonal_organ.omission_reason: Current V2 body rows select only cb_sensory or vnc_sensory, not sensory_ascending.

muscle_mapping_boundary.finding: The retained graph metadata can constrain anatomical motor pools, but it is not an explicit motor-neuron-to-muscle or motor-neuron-to-MuJoCo-actuator mapping table.

effective_coupling.distinction: The complete topology is retained in the artifact, but these source edges currently contribute exactly zero to recurrent dynamics.

deployed_v2_path.information_path: optic RGB and 43 body-local channels -> learned afferent currents -> full recurrent MaleCNS graph -> learned rank-64 factorization producing Z512 -> Rust resident -> 12 abstract actions -> engineered gait and PD actuation

readout.rank_scope: The linear map U V has rank at most 64; tanh outputs depend on 64 projected values. This does not claim that a matrix of Z observations has rank at most 64.

actuation.physical_mechanism: Engineered tripod oscillator, hip/knee target generation, twelve joint PD torques, and root posture correction.

interpretation.executed: The full curated graph is advanced with the current engineered graded-rate dynamics and learned interfaces.
interpretation.not_executed: No explicit anatomical motor-neuron-to-muscle transform or modality-specific auditory/proprioceptive transduction is deployed.
interpretation.historical_boundary: The 384 fixed population-mean neural-port interface is historical and separate; deployed V2 uses the learned rank-64 Z512 readout.
